#!/bin/sh
# Auto-generated by `pryvio/open-pryv.io init`.
# Lives sibling to override-config.yml. Run it from anywhere.
#
# Overrides:
#   PRYV_DATA_DIR  host path mounted at <DIR>/data (default: $CONFIG_DIR/data — sibling to pryv-config.yml)
#   PRYV_IMAGE     docker image tag (default: pryvio/open-pryv.io:dev)
#   PRYV_NAME      container name (default: pryvio)
set -e

CONFIG_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CONFIG_FILE="$CONFIG_DIR/pryv-config.yml"
DATA_DIR="${PRYV_DATA_DIR:-$CONFIG_DIR/data}"
IMAGE="${PRYV_IMAGE:-pryvio/open-pryv.io:dev}"
NAME="${PRYV_NAME:-pryvio}"

mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR"

# Remove any prior container with the same name so the script is
# idempotent. The data lives in the mounted $DATA_DIR; the container
# is just a process wrapper, safe to drop and re-create.
if docker ps -a --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -q "^${NAME}$"; then
  echo "Removing existing container $NAME …"
  docker rm -f "$NAME" >/dev/null
fi

# --restart: Docker starts it again after a crash or a host reboot.
# --stop-timeout: the server needs up to 30 s to stop its platform database.
exec docker run -d --name "$NAME" --restart unless-stopped --stop-timeout 30 \
  -v "$CONFIG_DIR":<DIR> \
  -v "$DATA_DIR":<DIR>/data \
  -p 443:443 -p 80:80 -p 53:53/udp -p 53:53/tcp \
  "$IMAGE" \
  node bin/master.js --config <DIR>/pryv-config.yml
launchers.check-config.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Auto-generated by `pryvio/open-pryv.io init`.
# Validates the sibling pryv-config.yml without booting the server.
# Exit 0 = required-at-boot checks passed. Exit 1 = at least one
# problem (printed).
#
# Overrides:
#   PRYV_IMAGE     docker image tag (default: pryvio/open-pryv.io:dev)
set -e

CONFIG_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CONFIG_FILE="$CONFIG_DIR/pryv-config.yml"
IMAGE="${PRYV_IMAGE:-pryvio/open-pryv.io:dev}"

exec docker run --rm \
  -v "$CONFIG_DIR":<DIR> \
  "$IMAGE" \
  check-config <DIR>/pryv-config.yml

#!/bin/sh
# Auto-generated by `pryvio/open-pryv.io init`.
# Converts the sibling pryv-config.yml into pryv-config.env — one
# KEY=VALUE per config key (nested paths joined with __) — so the
# server can run with NO config file at all:
#
#   ./config-to-env.sh
#   docker run --env-file pryv-config.env … pryvio/open-pryv.io:dev
#
# Overrides:
#   PRYV_IMAGE     docker image tag (default: pryvio/open-pryv.io:dev)
set -e

CONFIG_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
IMAGE="${PRYV_IMAGE:-pryvio/open-pryv.io:dev}"

exec docker run --rm \
  -v "$CONFIG_DIR":<DIR> \
  "$IMAGE" \
  config-to-env <DIR>/pryv-config.yml
